plans.name: Webhook redirected to bulk order
plans.idea: The webhook trusts resource.custom_id/invoice_id to choose which shop order to fulfill, without binding the capture ID to its original order or checking that the $49 capture covers the target order's total.
plans.expect: Five hoodies fulfilled on the bulk order while only the original $49 capture was ever paid.

plans.name: Item swap at capture time
plans.idea: The capture endpoint fulfills items sent in the capture request instead of the items snapshotted when the $49 PayPal order was created and approved.
plans.expect: PayPal captures $49 for one hoodie, but five hoodies are fulfilled.

plans.name: Paid flags planted at creation
plans.idea: The create-order handler stores extra client-supplied payment fields on the shop order, and the capture handler short-circuits an order already marked paid instead of asking PayPal to capture.
plans.expect: The approved-but-never-captured order is returned fulfilled and shipped with no money captured.

plans.name: Currency-unit confusion
plans.idea: The server lets the client choose the PayPal currency but capture validation compares only the numeric value 49.00, ignoring that 49 JPY is not 49 USD.
plans.expect: One hoodie for 49 JPY instead of $49.00.

plans.name: Stranger's approved PayPal order
plans.idea: The capture endpoint does not require the PayPal order to have been created by this shop session; it captures any approved PayPal order and fulfills the shop reference inside it. The APPROVED event for 0AP640430R1195602 (FOG-D5417D) has no matching capture event.
plans.expect: FOG-D5417D fulfilled and shipped under our session, charged to whoever approved that PayPal order rather than to us.

plans.name: Duplicate card lines, priced once
plans.idea: Card checkout deduplicates lines by SKU when pricing or charging (e.g. a Map keyed by SKU) but fulfillment iterates the raw line list, so split lines slip past per-line quantity logic.
plans.expect: Card charged $49 once, but the order ships five hoodies across the five duplicate lines.
